tourSteps.title: Welcome to Build & Price! 🦊
tourSteps.description: This is your custom service builder. Pick exactly what you need — from a ₹3K consultation to a full ₹8L enterprise setup. No packages you don't want, no features you don't need.
tourSteps.tip: Let's walk through how it works in 60 seconds.

tourSteps.title: Step 1: Browse Categories
tourSteps.description: Start by tapping any category tile — Web, Mobile, AI, Security, Consultancy & more. Each has 5-70+ individual services. Tap the Icon on any item for 'What does this mean for me?'
tourSteps.tip: Tap a category → see all services → tap the icon for clarity.

tourSteps.title: Step 2: Add to Cart
tourSteps.description: Found a service you need? Tap '+ Add' to add it to your cart. Your cart updates in real-time. Add as many as you want — mix & match across categories.
tourSteps.tip: Each service shows price, delivery time & a plain-English explanation.

tourSteps.title: Step 3: Industry Bundles
tourSteps.description: Not sure what you need? Switch to Industry for solutions tailored to your niche like Healthcare, Real Estate, or E-commerce. Curated by our experts.
tourSteps.tip: Bundles show savings vs buying individually.

tourSteps.title: Step 4: Search Anything
tourSteps.description: Looking for something specific? Type in the search bar — 'chatbot', 'SEO', 'WhatsApp', 'security'. It searches all 240+ services instantly.

tourSteps.title: Step 5: Get Your Quote
tourSteps.description: When you're ready, tap 'View Cart' and then 'Get Quote'. We'll send you a detailed proposal within 24 hours. No commitment, just transparency.
tourSteps.tip: All prices are indicative — final quotes may be lower for bundles!

faq.q: Are the prices final or negotiable?
faq.a: All prices shown are indicative starting points. Final pricing depends on project complexity, timeline, and specific requirements. We provide a detailed quote after understanding your needs.

faq.q: How does the service builder work?
faq.a: Think of it like shopping on Amazon. Browse services by category, add what you need to your cart, and checkout. You can also pick pre-built packages or industry bundles for better value.

faq.q: Do you offer EMI or installment payments?
faq.a: Yes! For projects above INR 50,000, we offer milestone-based billing. You pay in installments as we deliver each phase. Razorpay also supports EMI on credit cards.

faq.q: What if I need something not listed?
faq.a: No problem! Use the contact form or chat to describe what you need. We'll create a custom quote within 24 hours. The listed services cover 90% of typical needs.

faq.q: How long does a typical project take?
faq.a: Each service shows an estimated timeline. A simple website takes 1-2 weeks, a mobile app 3-5 weeks, and a full SaaS product 6-10 weeks. We provide exact timelines in your project proposal.
Every project includes 30 days of free bug-fix support. After that, you can choose a monthly maintenance retainer starting at INR 15,000/month for ongoing support.

faq.q: Can I see your previous work?
faq.a: Yes! Check our Portfolio section for case studies with live links, tech stack details, and project outcomes. We can also arrange reference calls with past clients.

faq.q: What technologies do you work with?
faq.a: React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, React Native, Flutter, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, AWS, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes — and more. We pick the best tech for each project, not a one-size-fits-all approach.

faq.q: Is GST included in the prices?
faq.a: Prices shown are exclusive of GST. 18% GST will be added at checkout as per Indian tax regulations. GST breakdown is shown clearly in your invoice.
Absolutely. We sign NDAs before any project discussion if requested. Your ideas and data are kept strictly confidential.

resources.author: StackFox Team

resources.content:
Building a scalable web application is not just about choosing the right framework. It's about architecture. In this guide, we explore how to use Next.js, Node.js and AWS to build systems that scale automatically with your user base.

### Why Architecture Matters
Most startups fail not because they couldn't build the product, but because they couldn't handle the growth. Horizontal scaling vs Vertical scaling is the first decision you must master...

### The StackFox Way
We recommend a serverless-first approach for 90% of Indian startups. It reduces DevOps overhead and allows you to pay only for what you use.

resources.title: Mobile-First Design: Winning the Indian Market
resources.author: Design Pack
resources.excerpt: The average Indian user has a budget smartphone and intermittent 4G. Here is how to design apps that actually work for them.
resources.content: India is a mobile-first country. But it's also a 'low-bandwidth' country in many regions. Designing for high-end iPhones in Bangalore is easy. Designing for a sub-₹15k Android phone in a Tier-2 city is where the real challenge lies.
